drift.note: Capacity rises in the fall and holiday season, so a moderate shift versus the prior year can be seasonal.

Run age shifts when the slate is dominated by long-running hits or by a wave of new openings; this is a real change in the show mix that the model sees as an input, so it is flagged rather than suppressed.
